description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2016 World Championships with the powers of darkness. Giratina-EX and Garbodor keep the opponent from doing almost anything, above all decks that rely on Special Energy; Max Elixir speeds things up, and Double Dragon Energy and Yveltal's Oblivion Wing power up Darkrai-EX's Dark Pulse. The 2016 World Championships were held at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis in San Francisco, California, from 19 to 21 August 2016.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2016 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
